question: India has ______ Km of land border and a coastline of 7,870.51Km including island territories.
solution:
The correct answer is __**11,098.81 **____** Km**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India has **11,098.81 ** Km** of land border.
 
• India also has a coastline of **7,870.5 Km** including island territories.
 
• The land border of India spans across seven countries: **Pakistan, China, Nepal, Bhutan, Myanmar, Bangladesh, and Afghanistan**.
 
• India's coastline touches the **Indian Ocean, Arabian Sea, and the Bay of Bengal**.
 
• The extensive land border and coastline play a crucial role in India's **geopolitical and strategic significance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India's border management is governed by various forces including the **Border Security Force (BSF), Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP), Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB), and Assam Rifles**.
 
• India's coastline is managed and protected by the **Indian Coast Guard** and the **Indian Navy**.
 
• Efforts to enhance border security include the construction of border fences, deployment of advanced surveillance technology, and bilateral agreements with neighboring countries.
 
• India's maritime boundary is crucial for trade, with major ports like **Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, and Visakhapatnam** playing a key role in international trade.
